summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on September 30, 2026, announcing payment of its semiannual Participating Debentures premium for the period January 1 to June 30, 2026. The premium totals R$512,161,695.81, or R$1.712064114 per participating debenture, on 299,148,666 outstanding debentures, with financial settlement on October 1, 2026. The premium reflects 1.80% of net iron ore sales and 1.25% of net copper concentrate sales from the Sossego mine. The prior 2H25 premium was R$2.341507529 per debenture. Taxes apply as fixed-income income. Investors should monitor iron ore and copper prices and any further optional acquisition offers, as these affect future premium distributions and debenture overhang.
